pairs.why: Both clocks share the same build, smooth semi-matte wood, warm color and soft studio light; the only differences are tiny pendulum and proportion shifts that don't change how close either is to the real cards.
These are near-duplicates with the same rendering and finish; B's slightly narrower case and longer pendulum don't move it toward or away from the real cards.
A's dome and case show slightly more wood-grain texture, and the lessons favor the smoother finish B has, though the gap is very small.
Both have the same smooth toy-like wood, gold trim and soft shadow on green, and neither is glossier, more textured or better built.
The two are essentially the same drawing; B's small crest on top and longer pendulum are minor details, not differences in style.
Rendering, color, light and construction match almost exactly, so I can see no meaningful difference in how close each is to the real cards.
These are near-identical clocks with the same moderate smoothness and finish, and both are equally plausible as cards from this game.
A and B differ only in tiny proportion and pendulum details, and their finish, light and build sit at the same distance from the real cards.
